description_compelling: Power moves up — courts neutered, parliament sidelined, opposition jailed, term limits scrapped. Judicial and legislative-constraint indices fall in a coordinated arc over years. The pattern fits backsliding democracies and consolidating autocracies; it preceded the Hungarian, Turkish, and Venezuelan transformations.
